description: Find the tables and views this connection can read by concept rather than by exact name: the query is matched against schema, object and column names and against whatever descriptions the catalogue carries, and each result says which of them matched. Leave query empty to page through the catalogue instead. Start here — the names it returns are the ones describe_table and run_query accept.

cursor.description: nextCursor from a previous search with the same query, schema, namePattern and includeViews, to continue its results.

includeViews.description: Include views as well as tables, default true.

namePattern.description: Keep only objects whose name matches this LIKE pattern: % stands for any run of characters and _ for one. Case- and accent-insensitive.

query.description: Words describing what you are looking for, such as customer orders. Matched against names and descriptions, ignoring case and accents. Omit to list every object.

refresh.description: Read the catalogue again instead of using the cached copy, default false. Use it after a schema change; it invalidates earlier cursors.

schema.description: Keep only objects in this schema. Case-insensitive.

name: search_catalog
